obligations.summary: The MCP should not disenroll a Member under 21 from ECM solely because the Member ages out of the adult ECM criteria upon turning 21.
obligations.sourceText: When a Member under 21 is served in ECM and does not meet the adult ECM criteria upon turning 21, the Member should not be disenrolled from ECM due to aging out alone; rather, the ECM Provider and MCP should apply the MCP’s usual, DHCS-approved “graduation” criteria to determine when the Member is ready to disenroll.

obligations.summary: The MCP and the ECM Provider should apply the MCP's usual, DHCS-approved graduation criteria to determine when a Member under 21 is ready to disenroll from ECM.

obligations.sourceText: MCPs must use the eligibility criteria provided to evaluate Members and may not impose additional eligibility requirements for authorization of ECM.
